originalTitle: U.S. stock futures drift higher with nonfarm payrolls in focus
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures rose slightly on Thursday evening, with market focus squarely on upcoming labor market data for more cues on the economy and interest rates.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures rose slightly on Thursday evening, with market focus squarely on upcoming labor market data for more cues on the economy and interest rates.

Soaring oil prices, after a report said Washington was sending more troops to the Middle East, also kept Wall Street on edge, as did a continued surge in Treasury yields.

S&P 500 Futures rose 0.1% to 7,732.0 points by 19:54 ET (23:54 GMT). Nasdaq 100 Futures rose 0.23% to 30,831.50 points, while Dow Jones Futures rose 0.07% to 51,276.0 points.

Nonfarm payrolls awaited for more rate cues

Nonfarm payrolls data for September is due on Friday morning, and is widely expected to factor into expectations for interest rates.

Any signs of labor market strength give the Federal Reserve more headroom to hike interest rates, especially as inflation remains above the central bank's 2% annual target.

Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday evening that interest rates will need to rise by at least 50 basis points to curb sticky inflation. Separately, Fed Governor Lisa Cook warned that artificial intelligence-driven inflation was a major risk for 2027.

Earlier in the day, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari also said he expects more rate hikes will be needed to cool the economy going into 2027, although he was unsure whether the next hike would come later in October.

Friday's payrolls print comes after PCE price index data for August, released on Wednesday, showed inflation eased slightly but remained well above the Fed's 2% annual target.

Sticky inflation and labor market strength are expected to set the Fed up for more interest rate hikes– a scenario that bodes poorly for Wall St.

Wall St buoyed by tech, but high yields, oil prices weigh

Wall Street indexes rose slightly on Thursday, aided chiefly by gains in technology and chipmaking stocks following blowout earnings from Micron Technology Inc (NASDAQ:MU).

The memory chip maker added 3% and spurred a 1.6% gain in the SOX after it clocked stronger-than-expected fiscal fourth-quarter earnings, and also presented an above-consensus outlook.

Micron said AI-fueled demand for chips remained robust and was expected to remain high in the coming years.

Gains in tech helped the S&P 500 close up 0.2%, while the NASDAQ Composite and Dow Jones Industrial Average firmed slightly.

Markets were spooked by Treasury yields extending their surge on Thursday, with the 10-year benchmark rising further past 5% and to a 24-year high.

High oil prices also weighed, as Brent surged 4% after a report said the U.S. was sending more troops to the Middle East, and that President Donald Trump planned to bomb Iran more in November.

chineseTitle: 美国股指期货走高，非农就业数据成为焦点

chineseContent:
Investing.com——周四晚间美国股指期货小幅上涨，市场主要关注即将公布的劳动力市场数据，以获取有关经济和利率的更多线索。

在有报道称华盛顿将向中东派遣更多军队后，油价飙升，也让华尔街感到紧张，美国国债收益率持续飙升。

截至东部时间 19:54（格林威治标准时间 23:54），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.1% 至 7,732.0 点。纳斯达克100期货上涨0.23%至30,831.50点，道琼斯期货上涨0.07%至51,276.0点。

非农就业数据等待更多利率线索

9 月份非农就业数据将于周五上午公布，人们普遍预计该数据将影响利率预期。

劳动力市场走强的任何迹象都会给美联储带来更大的加息空间，特别是在通胀仍高于美联储2%的年度目标的情况下。

达拉斯联储主席洛里·洛根周四晚间表示，利率需要上涨至少50个基点才能抑制粘性通胀。另外，美联储理事丽莎·库克警告称，人工智能驱动的通胀是 2027 年的主要风险。

当天早些时候，明尼阿波利斯联储主席 Neel Kashkari 还表示，他预计 2027 年之前将需要进一步加息来给经济降温，不过他不确定下一次加息是否会在 10 月晚些时候进行。

找不到合适的股票？我们的人工智能 10 月份投资者级股票精选名单刚刚下降 »

周三公布的 8 月份个人消费支出 (PCE) 物价指数数据显示，通胀略有放缓，但仍远高于美联储 2% 的年度目标。

粘性通胀和劳动力市场走强预计将促使美联储进一步加息——这对华尔街来说是一个不好的预兆。

华尔街受到科技股的提振，但高收益率和油价承压

华尔街股指周四小幅上涨，主要得益于美光科技公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MU）业绩井喷后科技股和芯片制造股上涨。

这家存储芯片制造商的第四财季盈利强于预期，并提出了高于市场普遍预期的前景，股价上涨 3%，带动 SOX 指数上涨 1.6%。

美光表示，人工智能推动的芯片需求依然强劲，预计未来几年仍将保持高位。

科技股的上涨帮助标准普尔 500 指数收盘上涨 0.2%，而纳斯达克综合指数和道琼斯工业平均指数则小幅坚挺。

周四，美国国债收益率延续飙升势头，令市场感到震惊，10 年期基准收益率进一步升至 5% 以上，升至 24 年来的新高。

高油价也造成压力，有报道称美国将向中东派遣更多军队，并且唐纳德·特朗普总统计划在 11 月对伊朗进行更多轰炸，布伦特原油价格飙升 4%。
